metadata.title: Embroidered Script and Avian Patch Graphic

retrievalProfile.description: A vintage-style embroidered patch featuring thick, interlocking script lettering layered over a stylized bird silhouette with realistic thread texture and heavy dimensional shadows.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, high-contrast graphic consisting of a vibrant green script wordmark with a thick brown drop shadow, superimposed on a red cardinal bird in flight, all rendered with a visible satin-stitch embroidery texture against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: The script lettering is the primary foreground element, partially obscuring the bird.
The bird acts as a structural backdrop, framing the text with its wings and tail.
Heavy brown drop shadows create a physical separation between the text and the bird.
The black background provides maximum contrast for the saturated red and green hues.
coreInvariants: Visible embroidery thread texture on all colored elements.
Thick, rounded script with interlocking swashes.
Deep, dimensional drop shadow with a felt-like appearance.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large initial capital letter of the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left flourish, follows the script to the right, then circles back through the bird's wing and tail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black void surrounding the central patch element.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the bird silhouette and dark brown for the shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a zero-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight cursive script with exaggerated swashes.
letterConstructionRules: Continuous baseline with interlocking descenders and ascenders.
Rounded terminals and thick, uniform stroke weight.
Deeply recessed counters within the loops.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital features a large, circular top flourish.
Lowercase 'g' and 'o' are tightly integrated with the tail of the preceding letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone custom script; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the thick, rounded, and interconnected feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a red cardinal bird in flight with a visible embroidery thread texture on a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a thick, green, custom-lettered script wordmark over the bird with a heavy brown 3D drop shadow and matching embroidery texture.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a visible satin-stitch texture?
Is the drop shadow thick and dimensional?
Is the bird silhouette clearly visible behind the text?

mustRedesign: Specific bird anatomy to avoid trademarked logos
Unique script flourishes to avoid font copying

avoid: Gradient fills instead of thread texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic thread direction in the embroidery.
Ensure the shadow aligns with a consistent light source.
Verify the interlocking script remains legible.
Confirm the bird's features are stylized rather than photographic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a stylized animal silhouette, apply a heavy satin-stitch texture, and overlay a bold, interlocking script wordmark with a deep 3D shadow, all set against a high-contrast void.
